## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant stage, requirement or issue.

## Validation

- Automated checks performed and their results:
- Manual verification and screenshots, when applicable:

## Compatibility and limitations

Describe schema, API, dependency or behavior changes and any remaining limitations. State whether generated data or checkpoint migration is needed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is limited to the requested task; unrelated findings are recorded separately.
- [ ] Relevant tests, lint, type checking and build pass.
- [ ] Documentation and the stage report reflect the implemented behavior.
- [ ] Frontend changes retain visual quality at the affected viewports.
- [ ] Final diff contains no secrets, generated datasets, checkpoints or environment files.
